title: Partner booking API — authenticate, create, amend and cancel bookings
context: Partner-facing HTTP booking API (no UI). Partners obtain a token and create, read, search, amend and cancel bookings; invalid bookings must be rejected predictably (400, never 5xx) and not stored.

rules.text: firstname: required non-empty string (valid: Ada; invalid: missing)
lastname: required non-empty string (valid: Lovelace; invalid: missing)
depositpaid: required boolean (valid: true; invalid: missing)
bookingdates.checkin: required date YYYY-MM-DD (valid: 2026-10-01; invalid: missing)
bookingdates.checkout: required date YYYY-MM-DD strictly after checkin (valid: checkin + 1 day; invalid: checkin - 4 days)

additionalneeds is an optional string; the other booking fields are firstname (string), lastname (string), totalprice (integer), depositpaid (boolean), bookingdates.checkin and bookingdates.checkout (YYYY-MM-DD)
A value exactly on a boundary is valid
Clients send Accept: application/json on every booking API call (general client instruction, not specific to one endpoint)

auth.mechanism: PUT, PATCH and DELETE /booking/{id} require either the cookie `token=<token from POST /auth>` or `Authorization: Basic <base64 of partner credentials>` (username:password, G9). POST /auth takes the credentials as JSON {username, password} (G2). All other endpoints need no authentication.
auth.credentials: attachments/partner-accounts.csv#L2 (role partner, public demo account of the test environment)

testData.strategy: Each test creates its own bookings with POST /booking (no authentication needed) and uses the bookingid from the response. Use a unique firstname/lastname per test so name searches (AC-5, AC-6 'not stored') are not disturbed by other users. Non-existent ids per G7.
constraints: Shared public sandbox (AUT profile restful-booker): other people write to it and data resets periodically; never rely on pre-existing bookings
Valid bookings must satisfy R1-R7; a valid baseline is firstname Ada, lastname Lovelace, totalprice 0 or more, depositpaid true, checkin 2026-10-01, checkout after checkin
testData.cleanup: Best effort: DELETE /booking/{id} with authentication for bookings a test created; the sandbox also resets periodically.

outOfScope: UI (story.md#L19: there is no UI; partners call the API directly)
